address: L307, 3F, Taikoo Hui, 383 Tianhe Road, Tianhe, Guangzhou, China Mainland
bio: The Singapore-based chain opened its first outpost here in 2019. The head chef from Hong Kong ensures that Chaozhou traditions are respected in the kitchen, while adding a refined touch to his repertoire. The fried tofu skin roll in sweet and sour sauce is filled with ground pork, water chestnuts, shiitake and dried shrimps, delivering a variety of textures. The pork tripe soup with salted mustard greens and peppercorns warms the heart and soul....
